description: This file defines the RecetteTek class, a subclass of Integration, responsible for importing recipe data from JSON files, processing ingredients, images, and metadata, and creating corresponding database objects in a Django project.

classes.name: RecetteTek
classes.description: A class for importing recipes from JSON files, extending the Integration class, with methods for filtering files, parsing recipes, and importing images.

methods.name: import_file_name_filter
methods.description: Filters zip info objects to identify recipe JSON files based on filename patterns.

methods.name: split_recipe_file
methods.description: Splits a JSON string into a list of recipe objects.

methods.name: get_recipe_from_file
methods.description: Creates and populates a Recipe object from a JSON recipe file, including ingredients, times, keywords, and images.

methods.name: get_file_from_recipe
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to generate a file from a Recipe object.
